item.title: RoundSignal 2026-W31: 9 freshly-funded accounts to sell to this week
item.description:
RoundSignal Issue 2026-W31

Freshly-funded B2B SaaS & tech startups (pre-seed -> Series B)

9 trigger-ready accounts, scored and contextualized.

telli

heat 88

Trigger: $15M Seed led by redalpine (Tech.eu / PYMNTS, as of 24 Jul 2026)

Why now: Berlin-based AI startup automating customer-facing operations just closed a $15M seed and is explicitly expanding its platform and team - fresh budget for growth, RevOps and go-to-market help.

Who to contact: CEO / Head of Growth · info@telli.com

Angle: Reference their plan to scale AI for customer-facing ops post-seed and offer to stand up the RevOps/onboarding funnel that turns new AI-agent demand into booked revenue.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Scape

heat 84

Trigger: $3.2M, emerged from stealth (Tech.eu, as of 24 Jul 2026); Y Combinator-backed

Why now: Two-founder Swedish YC startup reinventing email just launched from stealth with $3.2M - tiny team, new capital, and an immediate need for design, growth and dev capacity to launch.

Who to contact: Co-founder / CEO

Angle: Congratulate them on the stealth launch and pitch a fast product-marketing/launch sprint to convert the YC/email-reinvention buzz into signups.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Beelzebub

heat 83

Trigger: €3M Seed led by United Ventures (EU-Startups & Tech.eu, as of 27 Jul 2026)

Why now: Milan cybersecurity startup raised €3M and is explicitly funding research-team expansion and opening a new Rome commercial office - clear hiring, PR and go-to-market spend ahead.

Who to contact: CEO / Founder · info@beelzebub.com

Angle: Tie into their Rome office launch and offer recruiting or B2B demand-gen support to staff and fill the new commercial team quickly.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

PageMind

heat 80

Trigger: €1.2M funding round (Tech.eu, as of 23 Jul 2026)

Why now: Spanish AI e-commerce discovery startup raised €1.2M to expand its team and support US/international growth - early-stage with an explicit expansion mandate and small headcount.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Offer a US market-entry growth/localization package built for their stated international expansion off this seed round.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

kausable

heat 76

Trigger: €12M Seed round (Tech.eu, as of 23 Jul 2026)

Why now: European AI startup building reasoning-first frontier AI just raised a sizeable €12M seed - fresh capital typically drives engineering hiring and brand/PR buildout in the weeks after.

Who to contact: Founder / Head of Engineering

Angle: Reach out on the back of their €12M seed with a technical-recruiting or fractional infra-hiring offer to scale their reasoning-AI team fast.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Ossprey

heat 75

Trigger: $2.65M oversubscribed pre-seed (Tech.eu, as of 22 Jul 2026)

Why now: UK software supply-chain security startup raised $2.65M explicitly to accelerate product development and expand engineering and commercial teams - textbook early-stage services buyer.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Cite their stated plan to expand commercial and engineering teams and offer recruiting or go-to-market help to build their first sales motion.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Sowilo

heat 72

Trigger: Pre-seed round for Catecut fashion product-intelligence platform (Tech.eu, as of 21 Jul 2026)

Why now: Iceland-based AI startup raised pre-seed to expand Catecut and launch its Shopify app globally - very early, resource-light, and about to go to market.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Offer a Shopify app-launch growth/marketing sprint timed to their global rollout off the pre-seed.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Arrakis

heat 71

Trigger: ~$40M raised in just over three months, emerged from stealth; backed by OpenAI and Datadog leaders (Tech.eu, as of 22 Jul 2026)

Why now: London AI deployment startup came out of stealth with heavyweight backers and ~$40M - fresh, well-funded and building out team and brand right now.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO (ex-Accel Rafael Quintanilla)

Angle: Congratulate on the stealth exit with OpenAI/Datadog backing and offer senior engineering recruiting or launch-PR support during their scale-up.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Fincart

heat 63

Trigger: $2.8M raise to expand AI e-commerce platform (CairoScene, as of 27 Jul 2026)

Why now: (unverified) Cairo AI e-commerce startup raised $2.8M to expand its platform - single thin source, but an on-vertical early-stage raise with a clear expansion mandate.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Offer growth/dev capacity to accelerate the platform expansion they've earmarked this round for.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 24 — the signal decays within weeks.
